label: etched copper on flex top layer
description: Kapton Flex Substrate <-> UHF Radiating Patch - etched copper on the top layer at Z = 3.5 mm, centred at Y = 0. Patch footprint 170.4 x 148.8 mm.

label: etched copper on flex top layer
description: UHF Radiating Patch <-> L-Band Radiating Patch - L-band patch centre sits 250 mm along +Y from the UHF patch centre, giving ~65 mm edge-to-edge separation. Measured isolation -50 to -90 dB typical; this spacing must not be reduced.

label: flex stackup layer
description: UHF Radiating Patch <-> Underside RF Shield / Ground Plane - ground plane sits 3.5 mm below the patch layer at Z = 0, spanning the full 250 x 445 mm board. This 3.5 mm separation is the efficiency-critical dimension and must not be reduced.

label: plated via through substrate
description: UHF Radiating Patch <-> UHF Probe Feed Via - probe located 30 mm from patch centre along +X (the resonant length direction), passing vertically through the 3.5 mm substrate.

label: Flex PCB trace
description: UHF Probe Feed Via <-> UHF Matching Pad Site - matching pad cluster sits 8 mm along +X from the probe via, on the feed routing layer. Keep the trace short to minimise parasitic inductance at 460 MHz.

label: Flex PCB trace
description: UHF Matching Pad Site <-> UHF Radio U.FL - connector sits 8 mm along +X from the matching pad cluster.

label: plated via through substrate
description: L-Band Radiating Patch <-> L-Band Probe Feed Via - probe located 16 mm from patch centre along +X, passing vertically through the 3.5 mm substrate.

label: Flex PCB trace
description: L-Band Probe Feed Via <-> L-Band Matching Pad Site - matching pad cluster sits 6 mm along +X from the probe via. Trace length matters more here than at UHF; keep it as short as the pad cluster allows.

label: Flex PCB trace
description: L-Band Matching Pad Site <-> L-Band Video U.FL - connector sits 6 mm along +X from the matching pad cluster.

label: U.FL plug mated to receptacle
description: UHF Radio U.FL <-> UHF Coax Pigtail - pigtail plug mates vertically onto the receptacle. Provide strain relief within 20 mm of the connector; U.FL is rated for limited mating cycles and is the weakest mechanical point on the board.

label: U.FL plug mated to receptacle
description: L-Band Video U.FL <-> L-Band Coax Pigtail - pigtail plug mates vertically onto the receptacle. Same strain-relief requirement.

label: Laminated adhesive
description: UHF Matching Pad Site <-> Polyimide Protective Coverlay - coverlay laminated over the feed routing and matching region only. MUST NOT extend over the radiating patch area; added dielectric loading there detunes the band.

label: Laminated adhesive
description: L-Band Matching Pad Site <-> Polyimide Protective Coverlay - same lamination rule, patch area left clear.

label: conformal adhesive mount
description: Helmet Shell <-> Underside RF Shield / Ground Plane - the flex assembly mounts externally on the helmet side (Design 3: external side-mounted, not cut into the shell). Shield faces the head, patches face outward. Helmet model, shell material and approved mounting method [TO BE CLARIFIED].
